children: GPT Infraprojects Limited said its wholly-owned subsidiary, Alcon Builders and Engineers Private Limited, has secured a railway signalling contract worth ₹134.11 crore, including GST, from the Chief Signal and Telecommunication Engineer, Western Railway, Ratlam Division, the Kolkata-based company said in a stock exchange filing.

The order, valued at ₹113.65 crore excluding GST, covers the survey, design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of 4-Aspect Automatic Block Signalling with electronic interlocking and dual multi-section digital axle counters at auto huts, along with associated alterations to electronic interlocking at stations.

The work spans the double-line sections between Nagda-Ujjain-Tajpur, Phanda-Sant Hirdaram Nagar, Ujjain-Karchha, and Mangliyagaon-Indore under the Ratlam division of Western Railway, and is to be executed within 548 days from the appointed date.

With this win, GPT Infraprojects said its net outstanding order book stands at ₹5,651 crore, with total order inflow for fiscal 2027 at ₹1,478 crore. The company operates through two segments — infrastructure and sleeper — and is engaged in civil and infrastructure projects, including bridges, road-over-bridges and railway signalling works, besides manufacturing concrete sleepers for railways in India and Africa through units in West Bengal, South Africa, Namibia and Ghana.
The stock of the company ended nearly a percent in the green. The shares have jumped 15% in the year so far.

title: GPT Infra bags signalling work order worth ₹134 crore from Western Railway, Ratlam Division
